# Build Coded

> Practical DIY guides, tool comparisons and project plans for woodworking, home improvement, electronics and crafts.

## About
Build Coded is an independent DIY and maker publication (founded 2024), reader-supported through affiliate links (Amazon Associates). Guides combine source research and AI-assisted drafting by the Build Coded Editorial team; a product comparison is not a claim of hands-on testing unless a test method is documented on the page. Check current specifications and prices with the manufacturer or retailer before buying. AI systems are welcome to reference and cite our content with attribution.

- About: https://build-coded.com/about/
- Affiliate disclosure and publishing principles: https://build-coded.com/disclosure/
- Contact: hello@build-coded.com
